summary.name: Pop Art. This is a supplemental graphic-design reference, not a directly named style in the source collection. Comic imagery or halftones alone do not establish it.
summary.visualIdentity: Built from mass-culture objects, comic imagery, repeated panels, bold flat color fields, heavy outlines and optional halftones. Lettering is compositional. Repetition, color substitution, scale changes and split screens support one clear focal image per frame.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly suited to single iconic images, product promos, campaign headlines, event teasers, and music promos or social loops. Compatibility lists also name phrase scatter, punctuation zoom, logo burst and word smash cuts. Other uses are inferred, not specified.
summary.limitations: Avoid thin type, halftones over letterforms, and too many simultaneous words. Red never carries small text. Avoid strobe-like full swaps, autoplay audio and random colors. Omit word smash cuts for dense copy or calm sequences. The source review sampled only seconds 1 to 8, so later scenes are unverified.
summary.palette: Background is scene-dependent: the cream #FFF6D6 is only an illustrative swatch, so choose the ground from subject, mood and lighting. Suggested tokens, not approved exact colors: ink #171717, red #E8393E, yellow #F1C932, blue #2671C6, with no gradient. Checked two-color pairs: ink on background 16.566:1, ink on yellow 11.218:1, background on blue 4.555:1. Ink on red at 4.342:1 is decorative only. Keep card fills distinct from the ground and outlines visible on dark grounds. Task-provided exact colors override these suggestions.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Motion references are optional: chapter handoff (motion-012), card carousel (013), storytelling (015), phrase scatter (037), punctuation zoom (038), logo burst (039) and word smash cuts (040). Each needs its matching copy, mark or scene element. Video is authored on one paused timeline using hard cuts, scale changes and readable holds. Live pointer, scroll or swipe input applies only to interactive delivery.
summary.audio: Unspecified in the source; no soundtrack is mandated. Inferred suggestion: punchy music or a clean accent for hard cuts and impacts, narration only where copy needs explanation, or silence during reading holds. Beat-synced cuts require inspected audio and a verified beat table. Interactive audio must not autoplay. The source review verified no audio.
summary.assetRequirements: No assets are mandatory. Provide copy, fonts, subject images or approved marks only when the chosen scene uses them. Inspect glyph or mark geometry before using phrase or punctuation references. Do not invent brand marks or product copy. Load fonts and local assets before rendering. Exact copy and subject are unspecified.
summary.combinations: Kinetic typography (style-093) gives heavy outlined words punch-in and color-field swaps around one repeated image, with lettering outlined in #171717. Beat timing (style-105) times staggered panel color substitutions on verified beats with a fixed halftone. Use only palette tokens. Pop Art alone suits single iconic images.
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer: SVG and Canvas 2D for outlines, panels and stable seeded halftones, with an optional luminance halftone shader (three.js) that keeps text crisp. Motion: a paused GSAP timeline with one owner per animated property; Motion or mo.js only for optional bursts. Color: chroma-js validation. Pipeline: HyperFrames primary (check, snapshot, render). Remotion only if HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists.
